title.en: The position of an item in an array

description.sr:
Napiši funkciju `indexOfItem(items, target)` koja vraća indeks **prvog** elementa niza koji je strogo jednak (`===`) vrednosti `target`. Ako takvog elementa nema, vraća `-1`.

Primeri:
- `indexOfItem(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'b')` → `1`
- `indexOfItem([1, 2, 3], 4)` → `-1`
- `indexOfItem([5, 7, 5], 5)` → `0` (prvo pojavljivanje)

Preporuka: reši bez ugrađenog `indexOf`, sopstvenom petljom, jer je to cilj vežbe. Testovi proveravaju samo rezultat, ne i način.
description.en:
Write a function `indexOfItem(items, target)` that returns the index of the **first** element of the array that is strictly equal (`===`) to `target`. If there is no such element, it returns `-1`.

Examples:
- `indexOfItem(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'b')` → `1`
- `indexOfItem([1, 2, 3], 4)` → `-1`
- `indexOfItem([5, 7, 5], 5)` → `0` (the first occurrence)

Recommendation: solve it without the built-in `indexOf`, with your own loop, because that is the goal of the exercise. The tests check only the result, not the approach.

label.en: a loop with an early exit

text.sr:
Ovde pravimo (deklarišemo) funkciju. Funkcija je imenovan komad koda koji možemo da pozovemo koliko god puta hoćemo, svaki put sa drugim ulazom.

- `function indexOfItem` pravi funkciju sa tim imenom. Test je poziva baš tim imenom, pa mora biti napisano tačno ovako (velika i mala slova se razlikuju).
- `(items, target)` je lista parametara. Parametar je prazno „mesto“ za ulaz: `items` je niz u kome tražimo, a `target` je vrednost koju tražimo. Poziv `indexOfItem(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'b')` daje `items = ['a', 'b', 'c']` i `target = 'b'`.
- `{` otvara telo funkcije, a zatvara ga `}` u liniji 6.

Sama deklaracija ništa ne računa. Kod iz tela se izvršava tek kad funkciju pozovemo.
text.en:
Here we create (declare) a function. A function is a named piece of code that we can call as many times as we like, each time with different input.

- `function indexOfItem` creates a function with that name. The test calls it by exactly this name, so it must be spelled exactly like this (letter case matters).
- `(items, target)` is the parameter list. A parameter is an empty “slot” for input: `items` is the array we search in, and `target` is the value we look for. The call `indexOfItem(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'b')` gives `items = ['a', 'b', 'c']` and `target = 'b'`.
- `{` opens the function body, and `}` on line 6 closes it.

The declaration itself computes nothing. The code in the body runs only when we call the function.

text.sr:
Petlja `for` prolazi kroz sve indekse niza.

- `let i = 0` je **početak**: brojač `i` kreće od `0`, jer prvi element niza ima indeks 0.
- `i < items.length` je **uslov**: `items.length` je broj elemenata. Poslednji indeks je `length - 1`, zato je `<`, a ne `<=` (sa `<=` bi se pročitao element koji ne postoji).
- `i++` je **korak**: posle svakog prolaza `i` poraste za 1.
- Za prazan niz je `0 < 0` netačno odmah, pa se telo ne izvršava nijednom.
- `{` otvara telo petlje; zatvara ga `}` u liniji 4.

Brojač za niz od tri elementa:

```
i = 0  → 0 < 3 tačno → telo
i = 1  → 1 < 3 tačno → telo
i = 2  → 2 < 3 tačno → telo
i = 3  → 3 < 3 netačno → petlja se završava
```
text.en:
The `for` loop goes through all the indexes of the array.

- `let i = 0` is the **start**: the counter `i` begins at `0`, because the first element of the array has index 0.
- `i < items.length` is the **condition**: `items.length` is the number of elements. The last index is `length - 1`, so it is `<` and not `<=` (with `<=` an element that does not exist would be read).
- `i++` is the **step**: after every pass `i` grows by 1.
- For an empty array `0 < 0` is false right away, so the body does not run at all.
- `{` opens the loop body; it is closed by `}` on line 4.

The counter for an array of three elements:

```
i = 0  → 0 < 3 true  → body
i = 1  → 1 < 3 true  → body
i = 2  → 2 < 3 true  → body
i = 3  → 3 < 3 false → the loop ends
```

text.sr:
Ako je trenutni element tražena vrednost, vraćamo njegov indeks.

- `items[i]` čita element na indeksu `i`.
- `=== target` je stroga jednakost: poredi vrednost i tip. Zato je broj `1` različit od teksta `'1'` (skriveni test).
- `return i` vraća indeks i **odmah završava celu funkciju**, pa i petlju. To je „rani izlaz“: čim nađemo prvo poklapanje, ne tražimo dalje. Zato se za `[5, 7, 5]` vraća `0`, a ne `2`.
- Nema vitičastih zagrada, pa u `if` spada samo `return i`.

Tok za `indexOfItem(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'b')`:

```
i = 0  → 'a' === 'b'? ne
i = 1  → 'b' === 'b'? da → return 1   (petlja i funkcija se ovde završavaju)
```
text.en:
If the current element is the sought value, we return its index.

- `items[i]` reads the element at index `i`.
- `=== target` is strict equality: it compares value and type. That is why the number `1` is different from the text `'1'` (hidden test).
- `return i` returns the index and **ends the whole function immediately**, and the loop with it. This is an “early exit”: as soon as we find the first match, we do not search further. That is why `0` is returned for `[5, 7, 5]`, not `2`.
- There are no curly braces, so only `return i` belongs to the `if`.

Flow for `indexOfItem(['a', 'b', 'c'], 'b')`:

```
i = 0  → 'a' === 'b'? no
i = 1  → 'b' === 'b'? yes → return 1   (the loop and the function end here)
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo petlje otvoreno u liniji 2.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the loop body opened on line 2.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

text.sr:
Ako petlja prođe do kraja, elementa nema: vraćamo `-1`.

- Do ove linije se stiže samo ako nijedan `return i` iz linije 3 nije izvršen.
- `-1` je uobičajena oznaka „nije nađeno“, jer nijedan stvaran indeks nije negativan. Isto vraća ugrađeni `indexOf`.
- Namerno je izvan petlje: da je unutra, funkcija bi vratila `-1` već posle prvog elementa koji nije traženi.

Tok za `indexOfItem([1, 2, 3], 4)`:

```
i = 0  → 1 === 4? ne
i = 1  → 2 === 4? ne
i = 2  → 3 === 4? ne
kraj petlje → return -1
```
text.en:
If the loop runs to the end, the item does not exist: we return `-1`.

- This line is reached only if no `return i` from line 3 ran.
- `-1` is the usual “not found” marker, because no real index is negative. The built-in `indexOf` returns the same.
- It is deliberately outside the loop: if it were inside, the function would return `-1` already after the first element that is not the sought one.

Flow for `indexOfItem([1, 2, 3], 4)`:

```
i = 0  → 1 === 4? no
i = 1  → 2 === 4? no
i = 2  → 3 === 4? no
end of the loop → return -1
```

text.sr:
Zatvara telo funkcije otvoreno u liniji 1.

- `}` je par za `{`. Svaka otvorena `{` mora da ima svoju `}`; ako jedna fali, kod se ne može pročitati (`SyntaxError`).
text.en:
Closes the function body opened on line 1.

- `}` is the pair of `{`. Every opened `{` must have its `}`; if one is missing, the code cannot be read (`SyntaxError`).

note.sr: Petlja staje na prvom poklapanju (`return` u petlji), a `-1` znači „nema ga“.
note.en: The loop stops at the first match (`return` inside the loop), and `-1` means “it is not there”.
